dedupe_keys.name: consumi energetici mezzi comunali e trasporti pubblici 2007 2012

description: The Municipality of Lecce publishes energy consumption associated with its municipal vehicle fleet and public transport between 2007 and 2012. The catalogue provides a CSV resource under a public-sector energy heading. These observations describe an operational demand baseline for transport energy planning. They do not provide vehicle trajectories, passenger demand or a transport network model. The inspected metadata states the study period and the two fleet categories but does not give consumption units, fuel categories or a complete column dictionary. Access is public and free under Creative Commons Attribution; its version is not specified. A legacy shortened URL is used for the distribution, while the native catalogue API retains the dataset identity and description. The historical period should be preserved when comparing it with later fleet electrification. The related Lecce public-building electricity dataset concerns fixed assets, so no identity or direct combination of their measurements is claimed.
